## Cyrene (CR 2)

This small serpent has glossy black and green scales and curled horns flanking its fang-mouthed head.  

**XP** 600  
N Small magical beast  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision, low-light vision, scent.; Perception +4; **Aura** poisonous vapors (20 ft)  


**Defense**


**AC** 13, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+1 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 39 (3d10+9)  
**Fort** +6 Ref +4 Will +1  
**Defensive Abilities** corrosive blood; **Immune** acid  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +4 (1d4+1 plus poison)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 7, **Dex** 13, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 7  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 12 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse, Improved Initiative  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +5, Perception +4, Stealth +9; **Racial Modifiers** Stealth +4  
Languages—  


**Special Abilities**



**Corrosive Blood (Ex)** A cyrene basilisk’s blood is highly caustic. Every time the cyrene basilisk is damaged by a piercing or slashing weapon, the attacking creature takes 1d4 acid damage (or double damage if the attack is a critical hit). Using a reach weapon does not endanger the attacker in this way.  

**Poisonous Vapors (Su)** At the start of a cyrene basilisk’s turn, all creatures within 20 feet take 1 point of Constitution damage (DC 13 Fort negates).  

**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; save Fort DC 11; frequency 1/round for 2 rounds; initial effect 1 Con; secondary effect unconscious 1d4+1 rounds; cure 1 save.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any temperate or warm  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or nest (3-8)  
**Treasure** none
